title: 非农夜风暴来袭！币圈人必知的3大生存法则
subTitle:
币友们，今晚21:30，美国12月非农就业报告即将震撼登场，这极有可能是年底前币圈最大的“风暴眼”，一场波动率的盛宴即将开启！此刻，你是不是正紧盯屏幕，一边刷着非农前瞻，一边看着比特币K线上下翻飞？别慌，作为币圈老炮儿，今天就带你拨开迷雾，看懂这背后的逻辑，避开波动陷阱。
非农数据：盯紧这三大核心指标
很多人看非农，就只盯着“新增就业人数”，其实这不过是冰山一角。真正影响币圈走向的，是这三个数据的“组合拳”。
新增非农就业人数：这是最受瞩目的“门面担当”。市场预测值为18万人，比11月的15万人高。要是数据大幅超预期，比如超过25万，说明美国就业市场热得发烫；要是低于10万，那就是明显降温了。失业率：当前美国失业率已攀升至4.5%的近年高位，市场预计维持不变。一旦突破4.7%，美联储就得担心经济降温，降息预期就会瞬间升温。平均时薪增速：这可是通胀的“先锋官”。要是时薪增速超过4%，意味着薪资通胀螺旋风险仍在，美联储可能被迫维持高利率；若低于3.5%，降息的大门就打开了。
这三个数据一组合，直接决定了市场对美联储下一步动作的预期，而利率预期又直接决定了流入币圈的资金规模。简单来说，降息预期就是币圈的利好，加息预期就是币圈的利空。
三种情景推演：非农数据如何左右币圈
当下美国劳动力市场处于“降温但未崩溃”的状态，11月非农显示就业增长主要来自医疗、政府等防御性行业，制造业、建筑业等周期性行业已显疲态。基于此，我们推演三种可能情景：
情景1：数据大幅超预期（新增>25万，失业率<4.3%，时薪>4%）
这是币圈的“噩梦情景”。数据会直接打破市场对2026年初降息的幻想，甚至引发“加息重启”的猜测。历史教训惨痛，2025年9月非农超预期后，比特币1小时内从9万美元暴跌至8.5万美元，20亿美元仓位被清算，近10亿美元是多头头寸。高利率下，加密货币作为“高贝塔资产”会被优先抛售，持币成本上升，杠杆资金被迫平仓，资金流向国债等无风险资产。若出现此情景，比特币可能测试8万美元支撑位，山寨币跌幅大概率超主流币。
情景2：数据不及预期（新增<12万，失业率>4.7%，时薪<3.5%）
这是“利好情景”，但别高兴太早。数据公布后，市场会迅速定价“降息预期”，比特币可能快速冲高10% - 15%。不过，这种上涨往往是“昙花一现”。2025年6月非农不及预期时，比特币短线冲高至7.5万美元，但3天内又跌回6.8万美元。原因在于，市场已部分消化降息预期，且单一数据难改劳动力市场温和降温趋势，加密原生因素可能快速覆盖非农影响。所以，即便冲高，也要警惕回调风险。
情景3：数据符合预期（新增15 - 20万，失业率4.5%左右，时薪3.7% - 4%）
这是最可能出现的“中性情景”，也是最考验心态的。数据公布后，币圈可能先震荡后平稳，算法交易引发小幅波动，随后市场意识到数据未改变政策预期，价格回归震荡区间。此时，真正的风险是“市场噪音”，如自媒体放大“交易所合约爆仓”消息诱导散户跟风。此时，保持理性至关重要，别被短期波动带偏。
今晚操作指南：三大原则保平安
非农夜的最大风险，不是数据本身，而是人性的贪婪与恐惧。给大家三个实操建议，助你平稳度过今晚：
杠杆仓位务必减仓
历史数据显示，非农夜加密货币波动率比平时高3 - 5倍。即便你对数据有把握，也别满仓杠杆。2025年9月那波清算中，不少老玩家因“笃定数据利好”加5倍杠杆，最终爆仓离场。建议数据公布前，将杠杆比例降至1倍以下，或清掉杠杆仓位，只留现货。
不要盲目“赌方向”
很多人喜欢在非农前“赌单边行情”，提前满仓多单或空单。但非农数据“意外性”极高，专业机构预测也常偏差。去年11月非农前，90%分析师预测“数据疲软”，结果大幅超预期，不少空头被拉爆。今晚最佳策略是“等待明确信号”，等数据公布1小时、市场情绪稳定后再操作。
聚焦长期逻辑，忽略短期波动
对普通投资者来说，非农夜波动只是“短期噪音”。真正决定币圈长期走势的，是ETF资金持续流入、区块链技术落地、监管政策明朗等核心因素。若你的仓位基于长期逻辑布局，哪怕今晚波动20%，也别恐慌割肉。2024年以来，比特币经历12次非农夜波动，最终仍走出上涨趋势。

#zec  in debt, being pursued by collectors, earning 100,000 a month, those climbing up the mountain really have no right to mock those going down the mountain.

Many people forget - all those called 'gods' have also struggled at the bottom.

#ETH  At three in the morning, Old Li was kneading dough in front of the noodle stall, and his phone lit up.

Ethereum's weekly chart has shown a key bullish candle.

He replied to me with his flour-dusted hands: 'The funds have arrived, 500,000.'

Then he put the youtiao in the oil, the oil bubbling, a new day waking up together with a new fate.

Half a year ago, when he first sought my help, his voice was suppressed.

Online loan collections were coming one after another, his name was on the factory layoff list, and the tuition for his two children was hanging in the balance.

There was only 1200U left in his account, which he had saved little by little from his grocery money.

He said: 'This is my last chance to turn my life around.'

I didn't paint a rosy picture for him; I just told him to survive first.

1200U divided into three parts:

400U to learn the rules, 500U to slowly engage in spot trading, and 300U specifically reserved as margin.

Once he was stopped out, he was silent for a long time, saying the baby formula at home was almost gone.

The real turning point happened on a night of extreme panic.

The market crashed horribly, and I kept repeating one phrase:

Opportunities only arise when emotions break.

He gritted his teeth and added to his position at a critical point.

Two weeks later, his account broke 10,000 for the first time.

At that moment, he wasn't excited; he breathed a sigh of relief.

Later, I taught him to look at on-chain data and identify wash trading rhythms.

During the altcoin season, all the targets he laid out were realized;

Before Layer2 launched, he took his position in advance;

During a black swan event, while the entire network faced liquidation, he profited from the rebound due to his discipline.

Trading didn't give him a myth,

It only gave him the ability to stay clear-headed in despair.

He still makes youtiao every day,

But the aroma of flour now carries a bit more calmness.

If you are currently at a low point, don't rush to deny yourself.

Some mountains may seem distant, but step by step, you really can climb up.

网贷催收一条接一条，工厂裁员名单里有他名字，两个孩子的学费悬着。

账户里只剩 1200U，还是他从买菜钱里一点点省下来的。

他说：“这是我最后一次翻身的机会。”

1200U分三份：

400U学规则，500U慢慢做现货，300U专门留作保证金。

真正的转折，发生在一次极度恐慌的夜里。

市场砸得一塌糊涂，我只反复说一句话：

情绪崩的时候，机会才会出现。

他咬牙在关键位置补了仓。

两周后，账户第一次破万。

那一刻，他不是兴奋，是松了一口气。

后来我教他看链上数据、识别洗盘节奏。

他依然每天炸油条，

December 16th, Sister Ting talks about ETH

Dear friends, today's ETH market is quite clear: it's a technical rebound within an extreme bearish trend. Don't mistake the rebound for a reversal! The price has plummeted through the lower Bollinger Band at 2931.21, dropping to 2870 before rebounding back near the lower band. This is just a brief respite after the bears let off some steam; the overall downward trend remains unchanged.

The three Bollinger Bands are clearly opening downwards, with the middle band at 3067.68 and the distance between the middle and lower bands widening. The standard descending channel is still intact. The price is currently back at the lower band, but it has now become a resistance level. The middle band is the short-term dividing line between bulls and bears. Until it is broken, all upward movements are merely rebounds, and the current price is still over 130 points away from the middle band, making the rebound path full of obstacles.

Looking at the technical side, the price is firmly held down by EMA7 and MA7, clearly indicating a bearish arrangement. The candlestick has a long upper shadow, showing that as soon as the rebound showed its head, it was suppressed by selling pressure; the MACD double lines are in the deep water area below the zero line, with a green column at -32.7. Even if it has slightly shortened, the downward momentum is not exhausted. The trading volume is even more telling: the downtrend is accompanied by increased volume, while the rebound has decreased volume, a typical continuation of the downtrend, and the buying pressure is very weak.

The fundamentals are also extremely bearish, with a net outflow of $717 million in 24 hours! This is definitely a signal of large funds exiting, something retail investors cannot stir up. With 18.497 billion in high positions, the drop directly triggered a long liquidation, causing either liquidation or stop-loss for bulls, and subsequent fluctuations will definitely not be small.

Market sentiment is a mix of panic and hesitation; the crash has forced all panic selling out, and the weak rebound has made everyone afraid to take action. Now everyone sees the rebound as a chance to escape, confidence is shattered, and it could weaken again at any moment.

The trend analysis is very clear: don't even think about a direct V-shaped reversal; it's more likely to oscillate at low levels to find balance. $ZEC  The person who climbs up the mountain has no right to mock the god descending the mountain. Many people forget — the god also once climbed up from the valley.
At three in the morning, Old Zhang glanced at his phone screen during a break from kneading dough — the weekly chart of Ethereum was forming a decisive bullish candle. He wiped the flour off his hands and posted in the group: "Fishing Song, it's 500,000 now." Then he continued to fry the youtiao, and amidst the sizzling sound, a new day and new positions awakened together.

#ETH  Six months ago, when he found me, his voice was hoarse: overdue loan messages filled his phone, his name was on the factory layoff list, and the tuition for his two children was still unsettled. The only 1200U left in his hand was secretly taken from the grocery money, hidden from his wife. "Fishing Song, this is my last gamble."

A dead end is not the end, but the pivot of leverage. I had him divide that 1200U into three parts: 400U to learn contract basics, 500U for spot dollar-cost averaging, and 300U to keep for margin. Once, when a stop-loss order was triggered, he took out half a pack of cigarettes and said he remembered the baby formula can was running low.

The turning point began that deep night. At that time, the market was in a panic sell-off, and I repeatedly emphasized in the group: "When others are fearful, you must learn to be greedy." Old Zhang mortgaged the last gold jewelry from his hometown and added to his positions at the key support level. Two weeks later, when most people were still watching, his account first broke five digits.

I taught him to understand the language of on-chain data and to grasp the tricks of the big players. During the altcoin season in March, all three small coins we invested in doubled; in May, when the Layer 2 hype exploded, the positions he had laid out in advance made a profit of 200% in a single week. The most thrilling was during the black swan event — amidst the sound of liquidation across the network, he actually made a profit on the rebound because he strictly adhered to stop-loss discipline.

What trading has taught us is never the myth of getting rich overnight, but the ability to stay clear-headed in despair. Old Zhang still fries five hundred youtiao every day, but amidst the flour scent on his fingertips, the taste of freedom has already mingled in.
If you also want to carve out your own territory in the crypto world, Fishing Song is always here.

$ZEC 上山的人，没资格嘲笑下山的神。很多人忘了——神也曾从低谷里爬上来。
凌晨三点，老张在揉面间隙看了一眼手机屏幕——以太坊的周线正收出一根决定性的阳线。他擦了擦手上的面粉，在圈里发了句：“渔歌，50万了。”然后继续把油条下锅，滋啦声中，新的一天和新的仓位一起苏醒。

#ETH 六个月前，他找到我时，声音是哑的：网贷逾期短信塞满手机，工厂裁员名单上有他的名字，两个孩子的学费还没着落。手里仅剩的1200U，是他瞒着妻子从买菜钱里抠出来的。“渔歌，这是我最后一搏。”

绝境不是终点，而是杠杆的支点。我让他把那1200U分成三份：400U学习合约基础，500U做现货定投，300U留着补保证金。有次止损单被触发，他抽了半包烟，说想起孩子奶粉罐快见底了。

转机是从那个深夜开始的。当时市场恐慌性抛售，我在圈里反复强调：“别人恐惧时，你要学会贪婪。”老张抵押了老家最后的金饰，在关键支撑位加仓。两周后，当大多数人还在观望时，他的账户第一次突破五位数。

我教他看懂链上数据的语言，明白庄家洗盘的套路。三月那波山寨季，我们布局的三个小币种全部翻倍；五月Layer2热点爆发，他提前布局的仓位单周盈利200%。最惊险的是那次黑天鹅事件——全网爆仓声里，他因为严格执行止损纪律，反而在反弹中吃到反向利润。

交易教会我们的从来不是暴富神话，而是在绝望里保持清醒的能力。老张依然每天炸五百根油条，但指尖的面粉香里，已经混进了自由的味道。
如果你也想在币圈打下属于自己的那片江山，渔歌一直在。

As 2025 approaches its final stretch, the crypto market  particularly the altcoin segment , is entering a period of elevated vulnerability. Recent liquidation cascades exceeding $500 million within single sessions, dominated by long-side positioning, have exposed the fragility of leverage amid tightening liquidity and cautious institutional behavior.
Rather than signaling capitulation, the current environment reflects a market under stress from macro uncertainty, uneven capital flows, and structural imbalances between Bitcoin-led demand and altcoin participation. The result is heightened downside sensitivity across higher-beta assets.
Fear Dominates Short-Term Positioning
Investor sentiment has deteriorated sharply, with fear indicators registering extreme pessimism following successive drawdowns. Price corrections across majors have triggered cascading liquidations, amplifying volatility and reinforcing defensive positioning.
Bitcoin’s move below key psychological levels has acted as a pressure point for the broader market, while altcoins have underperformed disproportionately. On major spot venues, declining assets continue to outnumber advancers, underscoring weak breadth and limited dip-buying conviction.
Institutional flows have also softened. Periodic outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs, combined with reduced enthusiasm for Ethereum-linked products, have reinforced a capital concentration dynamic. Rather than rotating outward into altcoins, capital has remained defensive, delaying any meaningful recovery across the broader market.
Structural Drivers Behind the Weakness
Macroeconomic uncertainty remains a dominant influence. Shifting expectations around global central bank policy particularly speculation surrounding U.S. Federal Reserve guidance and potential adjustments from the Bank of Japan have contributed to tighter financial conditions and reduced risk tolerance.
On-chain participation metrics have also cooled, reflecting declining activity from both retail and institutional participants. At the same time, the structural dominance of Bitcoin-focused vehicles has redirected incremental demand away from altcoins, suppressing momentum and preventing the emergence of a sustained rotation cycle.
In this environment, leverage has become a liability. Thin liquidity and crowded positioning magnify downside moves, leaving altcoins especially exposed to forced unwinds.
Technical Structure: Compression at Critical Levels
From a structural standpoint, the altcoin market is approaching inflection zones. Aggregate market capitalization excluding Bitcoin and Ethereum is testing long-term support areas that have historically defined cycle transitions.
Sustained compression below these thresholds increases the probability of acceleration to the downside, particularly if broader market conditions deteriorate. However, oversold momentum readings across select assets suggest that relief rallies or short squeezes remain possible if price regains key resistance levels.
Such moves, if they occur, are likely to be tactical rather than trend-defining unless supported by renewed liquidity inflows and broader risk-on confirmation.

Positioning Considerations in a High-Volatility Regime
The current phase demands discipline rather than conviction. Elevated liquidation risk favors reduced leverage, clearly defined invalidation levels, and strategies that acknowledge bidirectional volatility.
Extreme pessimism has historically preceded medium-term opportunity, but timing remains critical. Without confirmation through structural reclaim levels and improving capital flows, premature positioning exposes participants to continued drawdowns rather than asymmetric upside.
Altcoins, in particular, remain sensitive to further deleveraging until broader market confidence stabilizes.
Risk Remains Elevated, Structure Matters Most
Late-2025 market conditions reflect adjustment rather than collapse. While altcoins face heightened liquidation risk amid fragile liquidity and macro uncertainty, the broader structural foundation of the market remains intact.
Near-term volatility is likely to persist as leverage is flushed and positioning resets. However, with regulatory clarity improving and institutional frameworks continuing to mature, the groundwork for a healthier setup into 2026 is gradually forming.
Until that transition materializes, patience, risk control, and structural awareness remain the defining advantages in navigating the current environment.

Recent Price Action Explained

ETH previously traded near the $3,300–$3,400 zone
Price started forming lower highs, signaling weakening bullish strength
A sharp breakdown occurred near $3,100
Strong selling pushed ETH toward the $2,900 support area
Current price action shows sideways consolidation after the drop

This pattern usually indicates that the market is absorbing selling pressure.

Momentum: Weak, but selling pressure is slowing

ETH must reclaim this zone to show short-term strength.

Volume Analysis

Current candles show reduced volume

Selling pressure has already played out

Low volume consolidation often precedes either a bounce or another breakdown.

Market Psychology at This Stage

Long-term holders are observing support behavior
Market sentiment is neutral to slightly bearish

This phase usually rewards patience, not aggressive trading.

What Would Confirm a Bullish Recovery?

Price closes above $3,050

Higher lows start forming on lower timeframes

Without these confirmations, any bounce should be treated as temporary relief.

Risk Factors to Keep in Mind

Risk management is essential at these levels.

Final Thoughts

Ethereum is currently trading at a decisive zone. The $2,880–$2,900 support is playing a key role in determining the next move. While the market is stabilizing after a sharp drop, no confirmed reversal has occurred yet.

ETH is in a wait-and-watch phase, where confirmation matters more than prediction.

title: BitMine Bets Big on Ethereum Despite Unrealized Losses: Tom Lee Says "The Best Days Are Yet to Come"
subTitle:
BitMine Immersion Technology (BMNR), one of the largest Ethereum-focused institutional treasury companies, is sticking to its aggressive accumulation strategy — even as market volatility shakes the crypto sector. Last week, the firm purchased 102,259 ETH, adding approximately $320 million worth of Ethereum to its holdings.
BitMine now holds around 4 million ETH in total, keeping it on track to meet its ambitious goal of controlling 5% of Ethereum’s total supply.
Despite the substantial acquisition, the company has maintained a strong cash position of $1 billion, with total assets reaching $13.2 billion. In addition to Ethereum, BitMine holds a limited amount of Bitcoin and a stake in Eightco (ORBS) — a digital asset manager focused on Worldcoin.

While Others Pull Back, BitMine Keeps Accumulating
As crypto prices remain under pressure and regulatory uncertainty weighs heavily on the sector, many digital asset treasury firms have paused or scaled down their purchases. However, BitMine and Bitcoin-focused MicroStrategy (MSTR) are among the few exceptions still actively accumulating.
BitMine is currently sitting on an estimated $3 billion in unrealized ETH losses, given that Ethereum is trading around 36% below its all-time high. Still, the company views this as an opportunity, not a setback.

Tom Lee: "Crypto's Brightest Days Are Still Ahead"
Tom Lee, Chairman of BitMine and founder of Fundstrat, remains bullish on crypto’s long-term prospects. In a recent statement, he said:
“2025 has brought several key developments for digital assets — including favorable legislation from Congress, a clearer regulatory framework, and growing support from Wall Street.”
He added:
“These developments reinforce our belief that the best days of crypto are still ahead of us. That’s why we’re continuing to accumulate ETH to reach our 5% supply target.”
While others retreat to the safety of cash, BitMine doubles down — confident that the future of digital assets is still being written.

title: XRP ETFs Log a Full Month of Inflows as Bitcoin and Ethereum Funds Suffer $4.6B in Outflows
subTitle:
US-listed spot XRP exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have quietly achieved a significant milestone, recording a full month of consecutive net inflows since their debut on November 13. This consistent performance sharply contrasts with the broader crypto ETF market, where Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs have collectively lost approximately $4.6 billion over the same period.
This development marks a turning point for XRP, an asset that spent years on the sidelines of traditional finance due to regulatory uncertainty stemming from Ripple’s prolonged legal battle with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). With the launch of spot ETFs removing that barrier, institutional capital is now flowing steadily into XRP, surprising even long-time bullish observers.
XRP ETFs Stand Alone in a Weak ETF Market
According to data from SoSoValue, XRP spot ETFs have recorded positive net inflows every single trading day since launch, pushing cumulative net inflows to approximately $990.9 million as of December 12.
Total net assets across the five US-listed XRP ETF products have climbed to around $1.18 billion, and notably, not a single day of net redemptions has been recorded.
This uninterrupted inflow streak is particularly striking given the broader market context. Over the same 30-day period:
US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw roughly $3.39 billion in net outflows, including a massive $903 million single-day withdrawal on November 20
Ethereum spot ETFs followed a similar trajectory, posting about $1.26 billion in net outflows
XRP ETFs, in contrast, never posted a negative flow day
December Highlights the Divergence
The divergence between XRP and the broader market became even more evident in December trading activity.
On December 1 alone:
XRP ETFs attracted $89.65 million in inflows
Bitcoin ETFs recorded just $8.48 million, roughly one-tenth of XRP’s inflow
Ethereum ETFs posted over $79 million in net outflows
Through December 12:
Bitcoin ETFs logged four negative flow days and eight positive days
Ethereum ETFs recorded five negative days and seven positive days
XRP ETFs maintained positive flows throughout the entire period
This consistency suggests that XRP ETF investors may be taking a longer-term, conviction-based approach rather than engaging in short-term trading.
Second-Fastest Crypto ETF to Reach $1 Billion
Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse highlighted the significance of the milestone, noting that XRP has become one of the fastest spot crypto ETFs to reach $1 billion in assets under management (AUM) in the US, second only to Ethereum.
“There’s pent-up demand for regulated crypto products,” Garlinghouse said. He also pointed to Vanguard’s recent decision to provide access to crypto ETFs through traditional retirement and investment accounts, dramatically expanding crypto’s reach.
According to Garlinghouse, crypto is now accessible to millions of investors who don’t need to be experts in blockchain technology, and for these new “off-chain crypto investors,” longevity, stability, and strong communities are becoming increasingly important factors.
CME Expands Institutional Access to XRP
Adding further momentum, CME Group announced the launch of Spot-Quoted XRP and Solana (SOL) futures on December 15, strengthening XRP’s institutional market infrastructure.
Giovanni Vicioso, Global Head of Cryptocurrency Products at CME Group, stated:
> “We’ve seen strong demand for our Spot-Quoted Bitcoin and Ether futures, with more than 1.3 million contracts traded since launch in June, and we are pleased to expand our offering to include XRP and SOL.”
The existing Spot-Quoted Bitcoin and Ether futures continue to show robust growth, with:
Average daily volume of 35,300 contracts in December
A record trade day of 60,700 combined contracts on November 24
Strong Inflows, Weak Price — A Structural Accumulation Phase?
Despite the powerful inflow trend, XRP’s price performance has lagged. Over the past month, XRP has declined nearly 15%, trading around $1.89 at the time of writing.
Market analysts suggest this disconnect may be explained by the mechanics of ETF markets. ETF creation and redemption processes involve delayed arbitrage, while market makers often hedge exposure using derivatives, which can mute immediate spot price impact.
Some analysts believe the flow data indicates structural accumulation rather than speculative trading.
“This is just five spot ETFs,” one analyst noted. “There’s no BlackRock yet, no 10–15 ETF exposure, but they’re coming. If weekly inflows remain near $200 million, cumulative inflows could exceed $10 billion by 2026.”
Conclusion
While Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs struggle with capital outflows amid macro uncertainty, XRP ETFs are quietly building a foundation of sustained institutional demand. The combination of regulatory clarity, consistent inflows, expanding derivatives infrastructure, and growing accessibility through traditional investment platforms may be laying the groundwork for a longer-term revaluation of XRP.
Price may lag in the short term, but the flow data tells a different story.

This could involve seeding the ETF, facilitating creation/redemption processes, or simply securing assets in a trusted, institutional-grade environment.

This BlackRock ETH deposit contributes to a broader narrative of institutional adoption, which brings:
Enhanced Liquidity: Large, stable holdings can improve market depth.

Price Stability Potential: While not guaranteed, long-term institutional holding can reduce volatile sell-side pressure.

title: 📊 Crypto Market Flash — Latest Update (Today)
subTitle:
The market is quiet again—but if you’ve been in crypto long enough, you know this kind of quiet rarely lasts.

I’ve been watching BTC closely today, and the structure is getting tighter by the hour. Price is compressing near key levels, and when Bitcoin does this, it’s usually not random. It’s the market loading a move while most traders get impatient.

🔥 Bitcoin (BTC) Price Action

BTC continues to trade in a narrow range around major support and resistance zones. Volatility has dropped, momentum has slowed, and price is coiling.

From experience, this kind of compression usually precedes expansion. The only question is direction.

What matters right now isn’t guessing the breakout—it’s identifying the levels that matter:

A clean break above the upper range would signal renewed strength

Losing the lower support would likely trigger fast downside momentum

This is a “wait-for-confirmation” zone, not a chase zone.

📈 Weekly Momentum Check

Zooming out, Bitcoin is still on track to close the week green. That alone tells me buyers haven’t disappeared.

Markets are digesting the latest US Federal Reserve rate outlook, and while there’s still caution, the tone feels less defensive than before. We’re not in full risk-on mode—but the panic selling phase seems behind us for now.

That’s usually how transitions start.

🌐 Altcoin Outlook

Altcoins are showing early signs of life, though not uniformly.

ETH is pushing higher and holding strength relative to BTC

XRP, SOL, ADA are more mixed, with selective moves rather than broad rallies

What’s interesting is the Altcoin Season Index ticking up slightly. This doesn’t mean “alt season” is here—but it does suggest capital is slowly rotating and testing risk again.

In markets like this, strong alts get stronger. Weak ones keep lagging.

🔎 Market Sentiment

Despite the range-bound price action, sentiment feels noticeably calmer than a few weeks ago.

Fear has cooled. Leverage isn’t extreme. And traders I speak with aren’t panicking—they’re positioning.

That combination usually leads to volatility, not stagnation.

🎯 My Take

When BTC holds a compression zone this long, it’s usually storing energy.

I’m watching:

A decisive break and hold above resistance for continuation

Or a rejection that confirms the range isn’t done yet

Until then, patience pays more than prediction.

Crypto doesn’t reward the loudest traders—it rewards the ones who respect structure and timing.

Final thought:
If volatility returns suddenly, will you be reacting to candles… or already aligned with the move?

That’s the difference between surviving the market—and thriving in it.

title: 出U遇赃款冻结“保命”全案略
subTitle:
前一秒还美滋滋看着账户里5万U，下一秒冻结短信和派出所电话就来了，直接把人从美梦中拉进现实噩梦，这在币圈可太常见了，不少人都经历过。
关键原则：碰上这事儿别慌，得有应对办法
光着急没用，关键得守住法律和事实的底线，说话得有技巧，这样才能解决问题。下面给大家详细说说。
面对警方询问：3个打死不能松口的和3个必须讲明白的
被质疑交易违法时打死不能松口：“我清楚这违法。”要是这么说，那可就把自己坑惨了。必须讲明白：“这就是我个人处理虚拟资产。法律是不保护，但这和洗钱、诈骗有本质区别，我可没破坏金融秩序。”被要求全额退赃时打死不能松口：“我全退，现在就退！”这样太被动，容易吃哑巴亏。必须讲明白：“我是善意取得，根本不知道钱来源有问题。我愿意在警方协调下，和受害人商量个合理的退赔比例。”被施压说不配合就有案底时打死不能松口：“我肯定配合，别抓我！”这种慌张的回应只会让自己更被动。必须讲明白：“我已经提供了完整的证据，积极配合调查了。我又不是嫌疑人，哪来的案底？除非把我认定为一级涉案卡，不然不能牵连我其他合法账户。”
终极预防：5道防线（交易前必须检查）
再好的应对，都不如不碰上这事儿。出U前花5分钟，做好下面这些，给自己筑牢防线：
身份防线：坚决不和那些“三无”（没实名、没流水、新注册）的账户交易，这种账户风险太大。渠道防线：只在大平台担保交易，千万别私下转账，大平台相对更有保障。证据防线：聊天记录、转账截图、链上哈希值，这三样一个都不能少，提前保存好，关键时刻能派上大用场。资金防线：专卡专用，交易资金赶紧进赶紧出，别在账户里留着，减少风险。心态防线：别被“高溢价”诱惑，哪有那么多天上掉馅饼的好事，小心掉进陷阱。
在币圈这种灰色地带混，安全就是唯一的护身符。记住，事前做好预防，比事后想办法补救强多了。守住底线，才能保住自己的资产。#巨鲸动向 #BTC #ETH

title: Ethereum aik Aham Mor par: Kya ETH Strong Comeback ke liye Ready hai ya Aur Girawat Baqi Hai?
subTitle:
ETH/USDT ka 1-hour chart is waqt bohat zyada volatility aur selling pressure show kar raha hai. Ethereum abhi $2,940 ke qareeb trade kar raha hai, jab ke price pehle $3,150–$3,200 zone se strong rejection ke baad neeche aayi. Is tez move ne market sentiment ko confidence se caution ki taraf shift kar diya hai.

Market Overview: Strength se Sharp Correction tak

Ethereum pehle $3,200 se upar stable trade kar raha tha aur buyers ka interest clear tha. Lekin achanak strong selling aayi jis ne multiple support levels ko tod diya. Price ne bina zyada rukawat ke $3,100 aur $3,000 levels break kar diye, jo strong bearish momentum ko show karta hai.

Aisi moves aksar profit-taking, market uncertainty, ya phir overall crypto market weakness ki wajah se hoti hain.

Important Support aur Resistance Levels

Chart par kuch key levels bohat important ho chuke hain:

Major Support: $2,880 – $2,920

Yeh area abhi demand zone ka kaam kar raha hai. Agar yeh hold karta hai to short-term recovery possible ho sakti hai.

Immediate Resistance: $3,000 – $3,050

Bullish confidence wapas lane ke liye ETH ka is psychological level ke upar close dena zaroori hai.

Strong Resistance: $3,150 – $3,200

Jo pehle support tha, ab strong resistance ban chuka hai.

Volume Analysis: Panic Selling ke baad Exhaustion

Sharp fall ke dauran volume ka bohat zyada increase hona panic selling aur stop-loss hits ko confirm karta hai. Ab jab price neeche stabilize ho rahi hai, to volume ka kam hona yeh signal deta hai ke sellers dheere dheere weak ho rahe hain.

Agar support ke qareeb buying volume barhta hai, to yeh relief bounce ka early signal ho sakta hai.

title: Why Scott Bessent Is Turning Up the Heat on Congressional Stock Trading
subTitle:
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is reviving a debate Washington keeps trying to outwait: lawmakers trading stocks while sitting closest to power and information.

His argument isn’t partisan. It’s credibility.

When congressional leaders are posting returns that beat elite hedge funds, something breaks. Not the market — public trust.

The numbers are hard to ignore. In 2024, Senate Finance Chair Ron Wyden’s portfolio jumped 123.8%, while the S&P 500 returned 24.9%. Nancy Pelosi’s portfolio gained 70.9% the same year. Since the 2012 STOCK Act, Pelosi’s cumulative returns reportedly reached 854%, versus 263% for the index.

Academic research backs up the pattern. An NBER working paper found that congressional leaders outperform peers by roughly 47% annually after assuming leadership roles. The edge comes from two places: direct political influence and access to nonpublic information — regulatory timing, government contracts, donor-linked companies. Advantages no retail investor gets.

Bessent’s warning lands at an interesting moment. Asset managers are already leaning hard into equities. Net long exposure in S&P 500 futures has reached 49%, near historic extremes, according to The Kobeissi Letter. Positioning has risen roughly 400% since 2022, more than two standard deviations above normal levels. Nasdaq futures show similar crowding. The S&P 500 has logged 37 all-time highs in 2025 alone.

Some analysts see a familiar pattern. Regulatory crackdowns on insider or political trading tend to show up late in bull cycles — when valuations are stretched, public frustration peaks, and insiders have already banked much of the upside. As EndGame Macro puts it: when the rules tighten for those closest to the information, the easy money is usually gone.

Public opinion is firmly on Bessent’s side. A 2024 YouGov poll found over 70% support across parties for banning congressional stock trading. Proposed legislation like the Restore Trust in Congress Act would force lawmakers and close family members to divest individual stocks, while still allowing ETFs and mutual funds. But momentum is thin. By December 2024, only 23 of 218 required signatures had been gathered to force a vote.

The pushback is familiar too — warnings that restrictions could discourage talented candidates from running. Others call the reform obvious, overdue, and foundational to basic governance.

Zooming out, this isn’t just about politics. It’s about market cycles. Record bullish positioning, rising scrutiny of insider advantages, and late-stage reform efforts tend to cluster near maturity, not at the start of new expansions.

That doesn’t mean an imminent crash. It does mean the easy asymmetries are being questioned — in equities, and increasingly across risk assets, including crypto.

When insiders start facing tighter rules, it’s usually because the party’s already well underway.

The Quiet Shift Powering ETH’s Strength
According to Jack Yi, the recent volatility surrounding ETH is not a sign of weakness—it’s evidence of market maturation.
Since the sharp market correction around October 10, spot liquidity has declined, but something more important has taken its place:
👉 Derivatives markets are now driving price discovery.
This shift signals a more sophisticated ecosystem where institutional players, hedging strategies, and leverage dynamics increasingly shape price action. Ethereum is no longer moving purely on retail emotion—it’s operating within a framework closer to traditional financial markets.
Rather than destabilizing ETH, this structural evolution strengthens its long-term valuation logic.
Volatility in Context: Cycles, Not Chaos
Yi emphasizes that recent price swings fall well within historical expectations when viewed through two proven lenses:
The four-year crypto market cycle
Seasonal volatility around year-end (especially December)
These recurring patterns have played out across multiple cycles. Short-term turbulence, particularly during late-year transitions, is not a breakdown—it’s a phase. For experienced investors, these periods often represent accumulation windows, not exit signals.
Strategy Over Timing: Playing the Long Game
Jack Yi is clear about one reality many avoid admitting:
Timing the exact bottom is nearly impossible.
Instead of chasing precision, he advocates for strategic patience—a mindset that has historically separated disciplined capital from emotional traders.
His framework for navigating current conditions is built on three pillars:
Cycle Awareness – Understanding where the market stands structurally, not emotionally
Market Evolution – Accepting derivatives as a dominant force in price behavior
Fundamental Focus – Prioritizing Ethereum’s technological and economic foundations
This approach doesn’t depend on headlines. It depends on conviction.
Ethereum: The Backbone of On-Chain Finance
From Yi’s perspective, ETH is not just an asset—it’s infrastructure.
Ethereum remains the settlement layer for decentralized finance, real-world asset tokenization, smart contracts, and emerging financial primitives. Its developer ecosystem, network effects, and continuous upgrades reinforce its role as the core asset of on-chain finance.
This is why short-term price weakness doesn’t invalidate the thesis. The utility, demand, and relevance of Ethereum continue to expand—quietly and consistently.

Diversification within the on-chain finance ecosystem allows investors to capture growth across multiple layers while anchoring portfolios around proven fundamentals.
LD Capital’s data-driven investment framework, built through extensive research, remains intact—unshaken by temporary volatility.
What Investors Should Take Away
Jack Yi’s message offers several practical insights for today’s market participants:
Market structure matters more than headlines
Derivatives dominance reflects institutional maturity, not fragility
Fundamentals outlast volatility
Time horizon is a competitive advantage
Ethereum’s value proposition isn’t defined by daily candles—it’s defined by adoption, infrastructure, and utility.
The Enduring Case for ETH Fundamentals
Jack Yi’s confidence in ETH fundamentals is rooted in observation, not hope. His analysis reflects a deep understanding of how crypto markets evolve—and why Ethereum continues to stand at the center of that evolution.
As the industry moves toward more sophisticated financial systems on-chain, assets with real utility, strong ecosystems, and structural relevance will matter most.

title: ETH清算额竟超BTC！加密市场恐慌蔓延，8.4万支撑能否守住？
subTitle:
比特币再度下跌，亚洲股市拖累行情
12月16日，比特币[#BTC ]开盘即下跌4.5%，一度跌至85.7万美元关口。与此同时，亚洲股市同样疲软，日经225指数下跌784点，跌幅达到1.56%。这波下跌直接拖累了加密货币市场，总市值一度下滑4.4%，不过在过去几个小时内略有反弹。

短期来看，比特币守住了85.7万美元支撑，并回升至86.5万美元，但市场仍充满恐慌和波动。CoinGlass数据显示，过去24小时内，加密市场被清算金额高达6.52亿美元。
以太坊清算额超比特币，杠杆风险暴露
有意思的是，这次清算中，以太坊(ETH)被强平的金额甚至超过了比特币。#ETH 的清算金额为2.335亿美元（多头头寸为2.051亿美元），而比特币为1.848亿美元（多头头寸1.688亿美元）。

XWIN Research Japan指出，这轮下跌并非现货抛售引发，而是关键支撑位下方的高杠杆清算累积导致。被强制平仓的多头头寸迫使市场产生卖单，形成连锁反应，加剧价格下跌。
AMBCrypto认为，这属于健康调整，清除了多余杠杆，也为后续稳定的现货驱动复苏创造了条件。
杠杆上升，波动可能继续
自12月7日以来，比特币未平仓合约量(OI)持续上升，尽管最近几小时有所回落，但整体趋势仍在增长。同时，预计杠杆率(ELR)也在上升。ELR指标衡量的是交易所未平仓合约量占代币储备的比例，其快速上升表明卖空活跃度增加，未来波动风险加大。

交易所的净流量数据显示，过去一个月比特币持续流出交易所，这解释了ELR指标的走势。同时，未平仓合约增加也意味着短期市场可能继续剧烈波动。
支撑位压力与市场情绪
目前市场仍然担心8.4万美元支撑位可能失守，这不仅是价格波动的担忧，也反映出更广泛的市场压力。链上分析师Axel Adler指出，市场阶段指数仍维持在0.38附近，说明过渡机制仍在维持，但抛售压力并未加剧，也没有出现明显的复苏迹象。

若该指标升至0.43以上，才可能发出市场走强信号。在此之前，投资者和交易员仍应保持谨慎，看跌情绪仍占主导。
总结：卖方主导，复苏仍需等待
亚洲交易时段，受投资者担忧情绪影响，比特币开盘即下跌近4.5%，市场仍由卖方主导。尽管短期内有小幅反弹，但可持续复苏尚未出现。交易者需要关注关键支撑位以及杠杆水平变化，谨慎操作为宜。

title: 以太坊顶不住了！3000 美元失守，ETF 连续撤资，多头被强平 2 亿美元！
subTitle:
以太坊这两天，真的有点顶不住了。
在整体市场情绪转向避险的背景下，ETH 价格再次跌破 3000 美元，而且这已经是本月第三次失守这个关键心理位。更扎心的是—— 美国现货以太坊 ETF 已经连续第三天出现资金净流出。
 ETF 资金加速流出，三天跑了近 3 亿美元

根据 SoSoValue 数据，12 月 15 日当天，9 只美国现货 ETH ETF 合计流出 2.247 亿美元，这是自 11 月 21 日以来，最大的一次单日净流出。
其中：
贝莱德的 IBIT 流出最多，约 1.39 亿美元灰度 ETHE 流出 3500 万美元灰度 ETH 流出 2000 万美元当天 没有任何一只 ETH ETF 出现资金流入
而这已经不是第一天了——连续 3 个交易日累计流出接近 2.865 亿美元。
更糟的是，12 月至今 ETH ETF 整体还是负的，延续了 11 月的颓势，上个月 ETF 总共被撤走 14.2 亿美元。
 ETH 跌破关键支撑，清算开始放大杀伤力

价格方面，ETH 一度跌到 2895 美元，随后小幅反弹，截至发稿在 2929 美元附近，24 小时跌幅超过 6%。
要知道，3000 美元在过去几周一直是多头死守的位置。
不少分析师之前就强调：
3000 不破，一切都好说；一旦跌破，麻烦就来了。
而这次，麻烦确实来了。
清算踩踏出现，多头被一波带走

随着 ETH 突然下破关键价位，市场出现明显的清算级联。
CoinGlass 数据显示：
ETH 期货市场多头被清算约 2.07 亿美元全市场加密清算总额高达 6.588 亿美元
简单说就是： 杠杆多头仓位扛不住，被强平，价格进一步被砸。
 为什么市场突然这么怂？关键在美联储

这波下跌，很大程度和宏观预期变化有关。
不少资金选择在美国就业数据公布前先撤退，因为这份数据将直接影响美联储未来一年的降息节奏。
更早之前，美联储在今年**第三次降息（25 个基点）**时已经释放信号：
 2026 年可能只会降息一次
这句话，直接让市场情绪变得谨慎。
而我们都知道——加密市场最喜欢“宽松预期”
一旦降息前景不明朗，风险资产往往先跌为敬。
 技术面也不太友好：看跌形态已经摆在台面上

从技术走势看，ETH 的日线图已经开始不好看了。

日线级别出现看跌旗形11 月下旬已经确认死亡交叉（50 日均线跌破 200 日均线）
这两个信号叠加，意味着： 在趋势真正反转之前，ETH 继续下探的概率并不低
如果跌破旗形下沿，
下一个关键目标在 2620 美元，也就是 11 月的低点区域。
 多头还有机会吗？盯紧这两个位置

当然，并不是说彻底没戏了。
接下来需要重点关注：
下方支撑：2620 美元上方关键阻力：3170 美元（与 23.6% 斐波那契回撤位重合）
👉 只有重新站上 3170 美元，
市场情绪和短线结构，才有机会从“偏空”重新转向“博反弹”。
一句话总结：
这次 #ETH  跌破 3000，不只是情绪问题，而是资金、宏观和技术面一起在“合力下压”。
短期别急着抄底，位置比情绪更重要。

إن هذه الموجة البيعية ليست معزولة، فمنذ بلوغ السقف التاريخي في أكتوبر، خسرت القيمة السوقية العالمية للعملات الرقمية أكثر من ١.٣ تريليون دولار من قيمتها، فانخفض سعر عملة بيتكوين BTC إلى ما دون مستوى ٨٦,٠٠٠ دولار، بينما انخفضت عملة إيثريوم ETH بأكثر من ٦٪ في تعاملات يوم الاثنين .
تحليل تفصيلي للخسائر والهبوط الحاد:
ووفقا للموقع إن البيانات الفنية تشير إلى أن هذا التراجع يمثل مرحلة تصحيحية عميقة وواسعة النطاق، فمن بين أكبر ١٠٠ عملة مشفرة، تتداول ٧٥ عملة حاليا أسفل متوسطاتها المتحركة الرئيسية لفترتي ٥٠ و ٢٠٠ يوم، بما في ذلك العملات الكبرى مثل البيتكوين #BTC  والإيثريوم #ETH  و #Solana  و #BNB  .
وهذا مؤشر قوي على أن الضغوط البيعية ليست مؤقتة، بل تعكس تحولا في الاتجاه العام، ويزيد الوضع سوءا أن ٨ عملات فقط من أصل المائة مصنفة في حالة "مفرطة في البيع"، مما يعني أن الغالبية العظمى من العملات لا تزال لديها مساحة إضافية للهبوط قبل بلوغ مستويات قد تدعم انتعاشا، هذه الصورة الفنية القاتمة تفسر استمرار الضغوط البيعية وانخفاض معنويات المستثمرين.
الأسباب الكامنة وراء موجة البيع الحالية:
وأوضح الموقع أن هذا الانهيار لم يأتي من فراغ، بل نتج عن مجموعة من العوامل المترابطة، فأدى تراجع شهية المخاطرة في الأسواق العالمية والتشاؤم حول البيانات الاقتصادية الأمريكية الرئيسية إلى انسحاب رؤوس الأموال من فئة الأصول الخطرة مثل العملات المشفرة، كما أن ضعف السيولة في السوق، يعد مشكلة تتفاقم مع اقتراب نهاية العام حيث يقل نشاط المتداولين، وأيضا الضغوط الفنية البحتة التي تواجه العملات، حيث تفشل في كسر مستويات المقاومة الرئيسية وتفقد مستويات الدعم الحاسمة، مثلما حدث مع عملة #XRP  الذي انكسر أدنى ١.٩٣ دولار .
وأخيرا هناك عامل "تعديل المراكز" في أسواق المشتقات، حيث يدفع الهبوط المتداولين ذوي الرافعة العالية إلى الخروج، مما يخلق حلقة مفرغة من البيع.
التوقعات والسيناريوهات المستقبلية المحتملة:
ويبدو أن المشهد في المدى القصير يتحول نحو المزيد من الحذر، فانخفض مؤشر الخوف والجشع للعملات المشفرة إلى ١٦ نقطة، مما يعكس حالة من الخوف الشديد في السوق، ويرى محللو FxPro أن السيناريو الأساسي الآن يتجه نحو اختبار منطقة ٨١,٠٠٠ دولار لعملة بيتكوين BTC كدعم محوري، وسط مخاطر استمرار الهبوط.
ويتوقع QCP Capital اتساع نطاق تداول عملة بيتكوين BTC بين ٨٤,٠٠٠ و ١٠٠,٠٠٠ دولار حتى نهاية العام، فتوصية الخبراء للمستثمرين في هذه المرحلة هي إدارة المخاطر، وتجنب الرافعة المالية العالية، والبحث عن علامات الاستقرار فوق مناطق الدعم القوية قبل التفكير في المراكز الجديدة.

【To be honest, the way ETH is moving right now makes it hard for me to sit still】

I watched ETH for a while during the trading session, and the structure is more stable than I imagined. The price is repeatedly hovering around 2928. To be honest, if this were in the past, I would have been unable to resist jumping in, but this round of consolidation has a different timing and rhythm. The RSI has also been pressed down to 34.8, clearly indicating a state of suppressed emotions.

This is not investment advice; I'm just rambling again.

In the past few days, the overall market hasn't seen much action, and ETH hasn't surged particularly strongly; instead, it seems to be slowly digesting the previous gains. This phase of pullback and consolidation is hard not to feel conflicted about—on one hand, you can see that the support below is still effective, with buying pressure whenever it approaches around 2900; but on the other hand, the volume hasn't expanded, and the upward momentum looks insufficient. I'm now wondering whether to continue to wait a bit longer before rising or to directly push up with this stability?

One possibility is that the RSI pulls back from the current area to a neutral range, combined with a slight increase in volume, leading to a small bullish continuation pattern, which could reignite short-term sentiment. After all, the price hasn't broken below key structural levels; if the main players really want to push further, there's no need to dump it into deep waters here. Another situation we must be cautious of: if it remains sideways for the next few days, with the RSI hovering around 35, it could evolve into a longer-term oscillation or even lead to another wave of testing support strength. This kind of movement is the most frustrating—experienced traders understand that it's either getting shaken out or averaging down as it falls, leading to increasingly heavy positions in the end.

As for me, I'm holding my base position without touching it, setting my additional buying points conservatively, primarily because I've suffered too many losses from “looking stable and suddenly tanking.” My current strategy is—don't guess the direction, just observe the actions. As long as it doesn't break down, I'll consider it a healthy adjustment; but if one day a large bearish candle engulfs the consolidation range of the previous days, then I must decisively acknowledge the mistake.

That said, this kind of market is best suited for exchanging time for space; there's no need to rush. How about you? Still on the bus?

【老实讲，ETH 现在这走法让我有点坐不住】

盘中盯着ETH看了一会儿，结构比想象中稳。价格停在2928这个位置反复磨，说实话换以前我早按耐不住追进去了，但这轮整理的时间和节奏有点不一样，RSI也压到了34.8，明显是情绪被压制住的状态。

这不是投资建议，这是我又在碎碎念。

最近几天大盘整体没太大动静，ETH也没冲得特别猛，反而像是把之前涨的部分慢慢消化。这种回踩整理的阶段，说不纠结是假的——一方面能看到下方支撑还在起作用，每次接近2900附近就有买盘托着；但另一方面量能又没放大，上攻动力看着不太足。我现在就在想，接下来到底是继续蹲一蹲再起，还是直接借着这股稳劲往上顶？

一种可能是，RSI从当前区域拉回中性区间，配合小幅放量，走出个小阳线接力的走势，那短期情绪就能重新热起来。毕竟现在这价位也没跌破关键结构位，主力要是真想继续推，完全没必要在这里砸深水潭。另一种情况也不得不防：如果这几天一直横着不动，RSI卡在35上下晃荡，那就可能演变成更长时间的震荡，甚至再来一波下探试探支撑力度。这种走法最磨人，老韭菜都懂，不是被洗出去就是越跌越补，最后仓位越来越重。

我自己是底仓拿着没动，加仓点设得比较克制，主要是吃过太多次“看着稳结果突然跳水”的亏。现在的策略就是——不猜方向，只看动作。只要不破位，我就当它是健康调整；但如果哪天一根大阴吞掉前几天的整理区间，那该认错也得果断。

话说回来，这种行情最适合拿时间换空间，急不得。你们呢？还在车上吗？

title: 以太坊ETF单日净流出2.25亿！机构抛售潮下，币圈风向变了？
subTitle:
昨夜币圈的深夜复盘群里，一组数据让不少资深玩家眉头紧锁——据ChainCatcher最新数据，昨日以太坊现货ETF单日净流出达2.2494亿美元，创下近两周以来的单日流出峰值。这并非孤立的资金异动，背后折射的机构持仓调整逻辑，或许正在重塑年末的加密市场格局。
先看这份流出数据的细节拆解，机构分化态势相当明显。贝莱德旗下核心产品ETHA成为资金流出的“重灾区”，单日流出1.3926亿美元，占总流出规模的61.9%，作为全球资管巨头的旗舰ETF，其资金动向历来被视为机构情绪的“晴雨表”。紧随其后的是灰度系产品，ETHE与灰度迷你ETH合计流出5528万美元，占比达24.6%，显示传统加密资管机构的减持意愿同样强烈。
对比之下，富达FETH（1096万美元）、Bitwise ETHW（1301万美元）等产品的流出规模相对可控，而21Shares CETH、景顺QETH等三家机构则呈现“零流动”状态。这种分化传递出关键信号：机构对以太坊的持仓调整并非一致看空，更多是基于自身投资组合的策略性再平衡。
要理解这波流出的底层逻辑，不能脱离当前的宏观市场环境。昨日同期数据显示，比特币已跌破8.6万美元关口，单日跌幅超4%，加密货币全网24小时合约爆仓规模达6.03亿美元，18.46万交易者惨遭“收割”。这种风险资产集体承压的背景下，以太坊ETF的资金流出本质上是市场避险情绪的延伸——正如FalconX交易员所言，当前加密市场仍深度绑定美股走势，而美股科技股的调整与美联储降息预期的降温，共同压制了风险偏好。
更深层的原因在于机构持仓的“跷跷板效应”。回顾2025年第四季度走势，以太坊ETF与比特币ETF的资金流向呈现显著背离：在以太坊ETF持续流出的同时，比特币ETF已连续三周录得净流入。这种切换并非偶然，而是机构对加密资产定位的再认知——比特币作为“数字黄金”的避险属性在动荡期更受青睐，而以太坊则因与DeFi、NFT等投机性叙事深度绑定，更容易成为资金收缩时的减持标的。从昨日数据看，贝莱德在减持ETHA的同时，其比特币ETF产品仍保持小额流入，进一步印证了这一逻辑。
这波流出对币圈的影响已开始显现，且呈现多维度传导特征。对以太坊自身而言，短期价格承压明显，昨日盘中一度跌至2932美元，较月初跌幅超15%，链上数据显示，近24小时内超7000枚ETH的杠杆多头头寸被清算，凸显抛压强度。对中小币种而言，以太坊作为“山寨币锚定标的”的效应开始发酵，多数DeFi代币单日跌幅超8%，与ETH的联动系数升至0.8以上。
但值得注意的是，市场并未出现恐慌性崩盘的迹象。一方面，21Shares CETH等产品的零流动表明部分机构仍在观望，并未加入抛售行列；另一方面，链上巨鲸数据显示，持有1万-10万枚ETH的大户在2900美元区间的增持量较上周增长30%，形成“机构抛、巨鲸接”的博弈格局。这种分化与2025年9月那次8亿美元大规模流出时的单边抛售形成鲜明对比，也暗示当前市场韧性有所提升。
对普通投资者而言，此次流出事件更像是一次“市场教学”。其一，需警惕ETF资金流向的“领先指标”作用——历史数据显示，以太坊ETF连续3日净流出后，价格出现深度调整的概率达68%，当前需密切关注后续两日的资金动向；其二，避免盲目追空，以太坊当前质押量仍维持在3340万枚的历史高位，通缩模型与Fusaka升级预期构成长期支撑，短期超卖后或存在技术性反弹机会；其三，优化仓位结构，可参考机构的“防御性配置”思路，适当提升比特币等避险资产的持仓占比。
年末的加密市场历来充满变数，此次2.25亿美元的ETF流出，与其说是“看空信号”，不如说是机构在宏观不确定性下的“预防性减仓”。正如灰度最新报告所言，以太坊的长期价值取决于其生态韧性，而非短期资金波动。对我们而言，与其纠结单日的资金流向，不如聚焦核心指标：3800美元能否重新站稳、DeFi锁仓量是否止跌、巨鲸持仓是否持续增长——这些才是判断市场拐点的关键。
最后留个问题给大家：你认为此次ETF流出是机构的“阶段性调仓”还是“趋势性看空”？你的仓位又做了哪些调整？评论区聊聊你的看法。#美联储降息 #ETH

ETHEREUM NEXT MOVE
The next significant move for Ethereum after the Pectra upgrade is the Fusaka hard fork, which focuses entirely on dramatically improving scalability and reducing costs for Layer 2 (L2) networks like Arbitrum and Optimism. Fusaka centers on architectural improvements, primarily introducing Peer Data Availability Sampling (PeerDAS), which will allow validators to verify data more efficiently without downloading the entire block, greatly easing the burden on node operators. This infrastructural change, combined with an increase in blob capacity (the temporary storage for L2 data), is expected to offer L2 networks up to 3.5 times more space to post transaction data, which in turn could drive L2 transaction fees close to zero and pave the way for handling 100,000+ transactions per second across the entire L2 ecosystem.

【ETH is a bit dangerous but also a bit tempting at this position】

People who are still trading late at night are basically not here just for fun.

At this moment, those watching ETH are feeling quite conflicted. At position 2934, it's not too high, but not too low either; the RSI is stuck at 47, neither going up nor down, which is a typical state of consolidation. This kind of situation is the most frustrating; if it goes up, you hesitate to chase; if it goes down, you fear missing out. As an old holder, having experienced several rounds of this kind of market, to be honest, this stage really feels a bit dangerous, but it also feels somewhat tempting.

On one hand, the market has not shown much movement these past few days, and the trading volume hasn't significantly increased, indicating that large funds are on the sidelines. When this kind of sideways movement drags on, it is most likely to suddenly make a big move, either crashing down to trigger a panic sell-off or directly shooting up to shake off people. From a trend perspective, it’s in a state of “consolidation,” which likely means a direction will need to be chosen soon; it just depends on which way the momentum will push. If we can hold this area steady and test upwards, combined with a warming sentiment, it might not be impossible to make a push. Conversely, if the broader market can't hold up and experiences a pullback, ETH is likely to take a dip as well, since it's not an independent market.

From another angle, the RSI hasn't entered the oversold zone, which means the selling pressure isn't particularly heavy, and there’s no extreme panic. This neutral and somewhat calm indicator status actually gives the bulls a bit of room. As long as the key support is not broken, I believe there is still a chance to slowly push upwards. Especially since on-chain activities haven't cooled down recently, staking and Gas have a certain level of heat; as long as the fundamentals don't collapse, the price won't really drop.

So my current strategy is: no adding positions, and no reckless cuts; just holding onto that little bit of base position and watching. If action is to be taken, it has to wait for a decent bullish candle or a substantial bearish candle before speaking. In this kind of market, surviving longer is more important than earning big. Don’t be fooled by others flaunting their profits; be clear about your own strength.

To be honest, I've been watching this position for a while.

In summary, at this position, there are opportunities upward, but also risks downward; it’s in a stage of “looks tempting but be careful not to get burned.” Brothers and sisters, control your speed, don’t get washed out, and don’t rush in headfirst. Keeping some bullets is always better than running out.

【ETH 现在这个位置，说实话有点危险也有点香】

凌晨还在刷盘的人，基本都不是来看热闹的。

这会儿盯着ETH的，心里都挺拧巴。2934这个位置，说高不高，说低也不算太低，RSI卡在47，不上不下，典型的震荡蓄力状态。这种时候最磨人，涨吧，不敢追；跌吧，又怕踏空。我这种老韭菜，经历过几轮这种行情，说实话，现在这阶段真有点危险，但也真有点香。

一方面，这几天盘面一直没太大动静，量能也没明显放大，说明大资金都在观望。这种横盘拖久了，最容易突然抽一口，要么往下砸一波杀点恐慌盘，要么直接拉上去甩人下车。从趋势看是“震荡蓄力”，那大概率是要选方向了，就看往哪边发力。要是能稳住这一片区域，往上试探，配合情绪回暖，未必不能冲一冲。但反过来说，要是大盘这边撑不住劲，来一波回调，ETH很可能也得跟着蹲一下，毕竟它也不是独立行情。

另一个角度想，RSI还没进超卖，说明抛压其实不算特别重，也没有极端恐慌。这种中性偏冷静的指标状态，反而给多头留了点余地。只要不破关键支撑，我觉得还是有机会慢慢往上拱。尤其最近链上活动没冷下来，质押和Gas都有一定热度，基本面没塌，价格也就不会真趴下。

title: Binance at Year-End: How the World’s Largest Crypto Exchange Closed 2025 Strong
subTitle:
As 2025 comes to an end, Binance once again stands at the center of the global cryptocurrency ecosystem. Despite a year marked by regulatory shifts, market volatility, and changing investor behavior, Binance has managed to close the year with resilience, innovation, and continued dominance in the crypto industry.$BTC 

A Year of Market Transition

Throughout 2025, crypto markets experienced periods of consolidation rather than explosive growth. Bitcoin and major altcoins traded within wide ranges, reflecting cautious sentiment across global financial markets. During this phase, Binance remained a critical liquidity hub, supporting millions of traders as capital rotated between spot markets, derivatives, and stablecoins.

Product Expansion and User Growth

Binance strengthened its ecosystem by expanding core services such as Binance Earn, Launchpool, and Futures. The exchange continued to attract both beginners and advanced traders by offering flexible earning options, deep liquidity, and competitive trading fees. Educational initiatives and simplified onboarding also helped bring new users into crypto during uncertain market conditions.

Regulation and Compliance Focus

One of Binance’s most important themes in 2025 was compliance. The exchange increased transparency, strengthened KYC and AML standards, and worked more closely with regulators across multiple regions. These efforts positioned Binance for long-term sustainability as global crypto regulations become clearer heading into 2026.

Innovation Beyond Trading

Beyond trading, Binance pushed deeper into Web3 infrastructure, including wallet services, blockchain development tools, and decentralized applications. By supporting builders and developers, Binance reinforced its role not just as an exchange, but as a foundational layer of the crypto economy.$ETH 

Looking Ahead to 2026

As the calendar turns, Binance enters 2026 with strong positioning. Improved regulatory clarity, growing institutional interest, and renewed retail participation could all act as catalysts for the next crypto cycle. With its scale, technology, and global reach, Binance is likely to remain a key driver of market activity in the year ahead.

Final Thoughts

Binance’s 2025 journey reflects the broader maturity of the crypto market. Rather than chasing hype, the focus shifted toward stability, infrastructure, and long-term growth. As traders and investors prepare for the next chapter, Binance closes the year not just surviving—but leading.

title: don't trust signals
subTitle:
Don’t Trust Signals — Trust Yourself

In trading, the biggest mistake beginners make is blindly following signals.
Signals may look attractive, but they slowly destroy your confidence, discipline, and learning process.

A signal does not teach you why a trade works.
It only tells you what to do — and that is dangerous.

When you depend on signals:

You don’t understand the market

You panic during drawdowns

You blame others for losses

You never grow as a trader

Signals create followers, not traders.

---

Make Yourself Perfect, Not Dependent

The market rewards skill, patience, and discipline — not shortcuts.

Instead of searching for the “best signal channel,” invest that time in:

Learning price action

Understanding market structure

Reading volume and liquidity

Managing risk properly

Perfection in trading does not mean no losses.
It means:

Controlled losses

Planned entries

Logical exits

Emotional stability

---

Create Your Own Possibilities

Every chart gives opportunities — but only to those who can read it.

When you analyze by yourself:

You enter with confidence

You accept losses calmly

You hold winners patiently

You improve every single day

Your edge is not someone else’s signal.
Your edge is your understanding.

The moment you take responsibility for your trades, you level up.

---

Take Positions by Your Own Logic

A self-made trade, even if it fails, is more valuable than a profitable signal trade.

Why? Because it teaches you:

What worked

What didn’t

What to improve next time

Losses are not enemies — they are fees for learning.

Professional traders don’t look for signals.
They look for confirmation.

---

Final Truth

Signals can give temporary profits.
Self-belief gives long-term consistency.

Stop chasing signals.
Start building skill.

The market respects traders who think, not those who copy.

Become the trader others follow — not the one who follows. #BTC #ETH

#ETH  Rolling positions is not gambling, it is the extreme focus that grows out of despair! Mr. Zhang from the clothing company transferred the last fifty thousand yuan into the trading account when the factory area outside was terrifyingly quiet. Two of the three workshops were stopped, and the warehouse was filled with out-of-season clothes. At forty years old, he had hit a reef in the tide of the real economy.

"This is not like purchasing goods," he stared at the screen, "this is using the last capital to buy a ticket to rejoin the table."

For the next thirty days, this middle-aged man who had only looked at fabric prices moved into the K-line chart. The office lights in the factory stayed on all night, and instant noodle boxes piled up beside the computer. That night, when fifty thousand turned into eighty thousand, he was not awakened at three in the morning for the first time; when the two hundred thousand threshold was broken, he withdrew the scheduled equipment transfer contract.

During the most thrilling week, the floating profit retreated by nearly half. He turned off his phone and walked around the workshop all night. By dawn, the first piece of clothing on the assembly line was still not formed, yet his account completed the most critical position increase.

Rolling positions is not gambling, it is the extreme focus that grows out of despair.

On the morning of the 31st day, the balance was fixed at 1.02 million. He did not cheer but walked to the window, watching the workers arriving for work, and sent a message to finance: "This month's salary, pay in advance."

Now, the computer in that office is still on, but the instant noodle boxes have been emptied. Mr. Zhang's business card still prints the clothing company, but his gaze is different — it is the unique calm of someone who has seen the abyss and climbed back up.

The most fair aspect of the cryptocurrency world is: it does not ask about your background, only responds to your cognition, courage, and discipline. One million is not just a number, it is the survival right that a real owner has snatched back at the turning point of the era.
Ambition needs wings, but more importantly than wings is knowing when to fold them.

The figure that completes cognitive breakthroughs in dire straits. The wind direction may change, but those who can ride the wind will always have another sky.

Mr. Zhang later said: this one million, half continues to delve deep within the circle, the other half became the wages in the hands of workers and brand new samples. "I used to lose sleep over inventory, now I lose sleep over opportunities — but this time, the sleeplessness is due to excitement."

If you are also looking for breakthroughs, perhaps you should ask yourself: what kind of focus and persistence are you willing to bet for change?

#ETH 滚仓不是赌博，是绝望里长出的极致专注！服装公司张总把最后五万块转进交易账户时，窗外的厂区安静得可怕。三个车间停了两个，仓库里堆满过季的衣裳。四十岁的他，在实体经济的浪潮里触了礁。

“这不像进货，”他盯着屏幕，“这是拿最后的本钱，买一张重新上牌桌的门票。”

接下来三十天，这个曾经只看布料行情的中年男人，住进了K线图里。工厂办公室的灯彻夜亮着，电脑旁堆满泡面盒。5万变成8万那晚，他第一次没在凌晨三点惊醒；20万关口突破时，他撤回了预定的设备转让合同。

最惊险的那周，浮盈回撤近半。他关掉手机，在车间走了整整一夜。天亮时，流水线上的第一件衣服还没成型，他的账户却完成了最关键的那次加仓。

滚仓不是赌博，是绝望里长出的极致专注。

第31天清晨，余额定格在102万。他没有欢呼，而是走到窗边，看着陆续上班的工人，给财务发了条信息：“这个月工资，提前发。”

现在，那间办公室的电脑还开着，但泡面箱已清空。张总的名片上依然印着服装公司，但眼神已不一样——那是见过深渊又爬上来的人特有的平静。

币圈最公平的地方在于：它不问你的出身，只回应你的认知、勇气和纪律。100万不只是数字，是一个实体老板在时代转角，为自己抢回的生存权。
野心需要翅膀，但比翅膀更重要的，是知道何时收拢羽翼。

在绝境中完成认知突围的身影。风口会变，但能御风而行的人，永远有下一片天空。

张总后来说：这100万，一半继续在圈内深耕，另一半变成了工人手上的工资和崭新的样衣。“以前为库存失眠，现在为时机失眠——但这次，失眠是因为兴奋。”

如果你也在寻找突破，或许该问自己：你愿意为改变，押上怎样的专注与坚持？

title: Whale Loses $20.4 Million on AI Agent Tokens After an 88% Portfolio Collapse
subTitle:
A crypto whale has recorded one of the largest single-investment losses in recent market history after a failed bet on AI agent tokens. The investor committed approximately $23 million into a basket of AI-related tokens on the Base blockchain, only to exit the entire position for just $2.58 million—resulting in a staggering $20.4 million loss, or an 88.77% drawdown.
Several individual tokens suffered catastrophic declines of up to 99%, highlighting growing concerns that the AI agent token narrative may have become one of the most speculative—and dangerous—trends in the crypto market.
On-Chain Data Reveals the Scale of the Loss
According to on-chain analytics firm Lookonchain, the whale’s portfolio consisted of six AI agent tokens, all deployed on Base. Every position ended deep in the red.
FAI: The largest allocation, resulting in a $9.87 million loss, down 92.31%
AIXBT: A loss of $7.81 million, representing an 83.74% decline
BOTTO: Fell by $936,000, down 83.62%
POLY: Lost $839,000, plunging 98.63%
NFTXBT: The steepest percentage drop, collapsing 99.13%, erasing $594,000
MAICRO: Declined 89.55%, losing $381,000
After fully exiting these positions, the wallet now holds just $3,584 in residual assets—mostly ETH and minor holdings in BYTE, MONK, and SANTA. The liquidation effectively marks a near-total wipeout of the whale’s AI agent exposure.
AI Agent Token Hype Faces Growing Scrutiny
The Base blockchain, developed by Coinbase, has become a popular launchpad for emerging AI-focused crypto projects due to low fees and strong retail participation. However, the sector has drawn increasing criticism for excessive hype and a lack of functioning products.
Many AI agent tokens promise autonomous, self-executing agents operating on-chain. While the concept is compelling, few projects have delivered real, scalable utility. As a result, prices often surge on narratives rather than fundamentals—only to collapse once speculative demand fades.
“This might be one of the worst investments ever. A whale or institution spent $23 million buying AI agent tokens on Base and sold everything today for only $2.58 million, resulting in a $20.43 million (−88.77%) loss,” Lookonchain commented.
The timing of the exit is also notable. AI-related crypto tokens peaked in late 2024 but experienced a 77% sector-wide drawdown in early 2025, as investor enthusiasm cooled and capital rotated into more established narratives.
Liquidity, Concentration, and Narrative Risk
A major factor behind the collapse was thin liquidity and highly concentrated ownership across AI agent tokens. When sentiment shifted, exits became crowded, and prices cascaded lower with minimal bid support.
This episode illustrates the risks of narrative-driven investing, especially in markets where:
Utility is unproven
Token supply is concentrated
Liquidity disappears during downturns
As the market matures, investors are increasingly demanding working products, measurable adoption, and real revenue models—not just whitepapers and marketing claims.
Risk Management Lessons from a $20 Million Mistake
From a risk management perspective, the whale’s strategy was deeply flawed.
Allocating $23 million across six highly correlated assets, all tied to the same speculative AI agent narrative on a single blockchain, amplified systematic risk. When sentiment turned, every position declined simultaneously.
Professional traders typically:
Limit exposure to unproven sectors
Diversify across narratives and liquidity profiles
Use position sizing and stop-loss strategies
In this case, the absence of disciplined risk controls allowed losses to compound rapidly. With several tokens down over 98%, even extraordinary rebounds would struggle to recover meaningful value.
Does This Signal the End for AI Agent Tokens?
It remains unclear whether this event marks the end of the AI agent token narrative or simply a brutal reset. Projects backed by strong technical teams, real development progress, and genuine use cases may still survive.
However, tokens relying purely on AI hype without execution are likely to continue underperforming as the market demands results over promises.
For now, this whale’s $20 million loss stands as a stark reminder: in crypto, narratives can change quickly—and without proper risk management, even large players are not immune.

title: Grayscale Predicts Bitcoin Will Reach a New All-Time High Within the Next Six Months
subTitle:
Grayscale analysts believe the crypto market is entering a powerful recovery phase, with demand strong enough to push Bitcoin toward a new all-time high in the first half of 2026.
This outlook was outlined in Grayscale’s newly released 2026 Digital Asset Outlook: Dawn of the Institutional Era, published earlier this week. The report identifies 10 key investment themes expected to shape the next phase of crypto market growth.
According to Grayscale, improving macroeconomic conditions, increasing institutional participation, and a clearer regulatory framework in the United States are creating a foundation for sustained upside across digital assets—led by Bitcoin.
Bitcoin Poised for New Highs as Macro and Regulation Align
Grayscale expects Bitcoin to experience strong price appreciation in early 2026, driven by rising macro demand for alternative stores of value and a more supportive regulatory environment in the US.
Importantly, the firm believes this period may also mark the end of the traditional “four-year crypto cycle” narrative that has historically guided investor expectations.
> “We expect valuations to continue rising into 2026, and we believe the four-year cycle framework will lose its dominance. In our view, Bitcoin is likely to set a new all-time high during the first half of the year.”
From a macro perspective, Grayscale highlights growing concerns around fiat currency debasement, fueled by expanding government debt and long-term inflation risks. As these risks intensify, investors are increasingly looking to allocate capital toward Bitcoin and Ether as alternative monetary assets within diversified portfolios.
US Regulatory Clarity Becomes a Long-Term Growth Catalyst
Grayscale notes that the regulatory stance toward crypto in the United States has shifted significantly over the past few years. Several developments underscore this change:
The dismissal of multiple high-profile lawsuits against crypto firms
The approval and launch of spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs
The passage of the GENIUS Act, which provides a regulatory framework for stablecoins
In 2024, spot Bitcoin and Ether exchange-traded products entered the market. In 2025, Congress passed the GENIUS Act, while regulators adjusted their approach—working more closely with the industry to provide clearer guidance while maintaining consumer protection and financial stability.
Looking ahead to 2026, Grayscale expects the US Congress to pass a comprehensive crypto market structure bill with bipartisan support. Such legislation could firmly anchor blockchain-based finance within US capital markets and further accelerate institutional capital inflows.
Grayscale’s 10 Key Crypto Investment Themes for 2026
Grayscale’s report outlines ten major investment themes that reflect the rapid expansion of real-world use cases across public blockchains.
Key highlights include:
Stablecoins entering a new growth phase, supported by the GENIUS Act
Tokenization of real-world assets reaching an inflection point
DeFi acceleration, driven primarily by lending protocols
Staking becoming the default investment strategy for long-term crypto holders
Grayscale expects tangible real-world outcomes in 2026, including stablecoins being integrated into cross-border payments, used as collateral on derivatives exchanges, appearing on corporate balance sheets, and increasingly serving as alternatives to credit cards in online payments.
Themes Unlikely to Drive Market Impact in 2026
On the other hand, Grayscale identifies two areas that are unlikely to meaningfully influence crypto valuations in the near term:
Quantum computing
Digital Asset Treasuries (DATs)
While research into post-quantum cryptography is expected to continue, Grayscale believes it will not materially affect asset prices in 2026. Similarly, despite significant media attention, DAT models are unlikely to become a decisive driver of crypto market trends in the coming year.
Final Thoughts: A Structural Shift Toward an Institutional Era
Grayscale’s outlook suggests that 2026 could represent a structural turning point for crypto markets. With clearer regulation, growing institutional adoption, and macroeconomic tailwinds converging, Bitcoin may not only reach new highs—but do so within a more mature and integrated financial ecosystem.
If these trends hold, the next rally may look fundamentally different from previous cycles, driven less by speculation and more by long-term capital allocation.

title: الذهب يقترب من أعلى مستوى له مرة أخرى بينما يصل البيتكوين إلى أدنى مستوى تاريخي—هل هناك تناوب قادم؟
subTitle:
ارتفعت أسعار الذهب قليلا يوم الثلاثاء، حيث تم تداولها عند 4,305 دولار للأونصة—ضمن مسافة قريبة من أعلى مستوى له على الإطلاق في أكتوبر عند 4,381 دولار.
يعكس هذا الارتفاع هروبا أوسع نحو الأمان بينما يتعامل المستثمرون مع السياسة النقدية غير المؤكدة ويسعون للتحوط من التضخم. مع تسعير الأسواق لاحتمال خفض سعر الفائدة مرة أخرى بنسبة 76٪ في يناير، ازدادت جاذبية الذهب كأصل غير عائد العائد.
إشارات التباعد التاريخي لنقطة تحول محتملة
وفر الدولار الأمريكي، الذي كان بالقرب من أدنى مستوى له خلال الشهر خلال الجلسة الآسيوية، رياحا خلفية إضافية للسبائك. ارتفع الذهب بأكثر من 64٪ منذ بداية العام، مما يمثل أفضل أداء سنوي له منذ عام 1979. أدت تخفيضات أسعار الفائدة من قبل الاحتياطي الفيدرالي، واستمرار شراء البنوك المركزية، والتدفقات المستمرة إلى صناديق المؤشرات المدعومة بالذهب إلى زيادة السعر.
ارتفعت الحصص في صناديق البورصة المدعومة بالذهب كل شهر هذا العام باستثناء مايو، وفقا لمجلس الذهب العالمي، مما يبرز استمرار شهية المستثمرين لهذا الأصل الآمن. مع انخفاض الأسعار، تنخفض تكلفة الفرصة البديلة للاحتفاظ بالذهب، مما يجعله أكثر جاذبية مقارنة بالاستثمارات التي تحمل فوائد.
وفي الوقت نفسه، لا يزال سعر البيتكوين يتراوح حول 86,000 دولار بعد أن أدى صفع حاد إلى تصفيات طويلة مدتها ساعة بقيمة 200 مليون دولار يوم الاثنين. لا تزال العملة الرقمية الرائدة أقل بحوالي 30٪ من ذروتها في أكتوبر عند 126,210 دولار. بينما يعمل الذهب كأصل آمن في الأوقات العصيبة، غالبا ما يتداول البيتكوين كأصل مخاطرة، حيث يعاني من تدفقات خارجية عندما يسعى المستثمرون إلى الاستقرار.
لقد لفت الفجوة المتزايدة بين الذهب والبيتكوين انتباه محللي السوق. أشار متداول العملات الرقمية مايكل فان دي بوبي إلى أن مؤشر القوة النسبية للبيتكوين مقابل الذهب انخفض إلى أقل من 30 للمرة الرابعة فقط في التاريخ.
يدعم التحليل الفني من المحلل الآخر Misterrcrypto هذا الرأي. يظهر أن زوج BTC/Gold يختبر خط دعم صاعد طويل الأمد للمرة الرابعة منذ 2019. مؤشر Z-Score هو -1.76، في منطقة الإفراط في البيع، وقد أدت لمسات سابقة لهذا المستوى الداعم إلى ارتفاعات كبيرة.
ومع ذلك، لا تضمن الأنماط الفنية تحركات مستقبلية. تختلف البيئة الاقتصادية الكلية الحالية عن الدورات السابقة، حيث يبقى التضخم مرتفعا وتستمر المخاطر الجيوسياسية في دعم الطلب على الذهب. لا يزال مدى تحول المستثمرين من الذهب إلى البيتكوين غير مؤكد.
العوامل الكلية في التركيز
تراقب الأسواق عن كثب بيانات الاقتصاد الأمريكي لهذا الأسبوع لسد الفراغ الذي أحدثه إغلاق حكومي دام ستة أسابيع. يصدر مكتب إحصاءات العمل يوم الثلاثاء تقارير التوظيف المجمعة المنتظرة لشهري أكتوبر ونوفمبر. ومع ذلك، ستغيب تفاصيل رئيسية — بما في ذلك معدل البطالة في أكتوبر، مما أدى إلى أول فجوة في تلك السلسلة الحيوية من البيانات.
يتوقع الاقتصاديون زيادة في الرواتب بمقدار 50,000 ومعدل بطالة 4.5٪، مما يتماشى مع سوق العمل البطيء لكنه مستقر. حتى الضعف المعتدل في الأرقام سيعزز الحجة لصالح المزيد من خفض أسعار الفائدة، وفقا للاستراتيجي في مورغان ستانلي مايكل ويلسون.
قدم الاحتياطي الفيدرالي تخفيض سعر الفائدة بنسبة 25 نقطة أساس الأسبوع الماضي لكنه أشار إلى احتمال توقف وسط استمرار التضخم. ومع ذلك، قال محافظ الاحتياطي الفيدرالي ستيفن ميران يوم الاثنين إن التضخم الحالي فوق الهدف لا يعكس الديناميكيات الأساسية، مؤكدا أن "الأسعار أصبحت مستقرة مرة أخرى." يقيم المستثمرون حاليا احتمال بنسبة 76٪ لتخفيض آخر في يناير.
النظرة الفنية
تكشف بيانات خيارات البيتكوين عن اهتمام مفتوح كبير يتركز حول تاريخ انتهاء صلاحية 26 ديسمبر، مع مراكز ثقيلة عند تنفيذ 100,000 دولار. يحدد المحللون نطاق جاما يتراوح بين 86,000 و110,000 دولار، مما يشير إلى تقلب متزايد مع إعادة الترتيب للمتداولين مع اقتراب نهاية العام.
تراجعت الفضة أكثر من الضعف هذا العام مع زيادة بنسبة 121٪، من أعلى مستوى لها يوم الجمعة عند 64.65 دولار، لكنها لا تزال قريبة من المستويات التاريخية. وقد دفعه الارتفاع إلى تشديد المخزونات، والطلب الصناعي القوي، وإدراجه في قائمة المعادن الحيوية الأمريكية.
مع اقتراب الذهب من مستويات قمم جديدة وتوحيد البيتكوين بالقرب من مستويات الدعم الرئيسية، قد تحدد الأسابيع القادمة ما إذا كان التباعد التاريخي بين الأصولين سيحل من خلال التناوب—أو سيزداد الاضطرار

translatedData.content:
【Staring at ETH for half a day, this trend doesn't look like something retail investors would casually walk away from】

Sitting down in the evening to seriously watch the market, ETH has started to feel a bit different. It has been hovering around the current price of 2937.56 for the past few days, unlike the previous erratic movements. It seems more like a consolidation phase, with some order in it. The RSI is currently at 36.0, not too high and not too low, just at a position where it can catch its breath.

To be honest, as an old retail investor, what I fear most is disorderly fluctuations, but this trend now, with no obvious shrinkage in volume and the pullbacks not breaking previous low support levels, instead, every dip seems to have capital supporting it, as if someone is quietly accumulating at the bottom. Look at the K-lines from the last two days, the bearish candlestick bodies are short, and the bullish ones are not in a hurry to push up, taking steady steps with patience. This kind of movement could mean that the main force is still washing out positions, waiting for the last batch of panic sellers to hand over their chips; or it could be preparing for the next wave, gathering strength.

I think there are two possibilities moving forward. One is to continue sideways for a few days, exhausting more short-term traders, and then suddenly increase volume to push up, directly breaking the wait-and-see sentiment. If this situation coincides with the market stabilizing, the win rate would be higher. The other is to test lower again, fill a gap or something, tricking in all the technical traders before reversing and pushing up. This kind of movement is quite ruthless, specifically targeting bottom fishers, but from what I see, the current capital situation isn't that weak; if there is a deep correction, it would probably need some news to accompany it.

Overall, I lean slightly bullish but don't dare to go heavy on calls. After all, it’s not the crazy bull market like last year, and market sentiment is still cautious. However, at this level, ETH looks much more solid compared to those messy small coins. Those who can hold onto it can continue to do so, and those who want to increase their positions should not go all in at once; it’s safer to do it in batches.

Anyway, I’m just watching and waiting now, not in a hurry. This consolidation period is the most grinding but also the easiest time to find opportunities. Just one thing to say: don’t get thrown off the bus, and don’t be too greedy.

title: لماذا مستقبل العملات المشفرة متفائل؟
subTitle:
لقد مرت سوق العملات المشفرة بدورات مكثفة في السنوات الأخيرة، لكن شيء واحد أصبح واضحًا: القطاع نضج. عند النظر إلى السنوات المقبلة، تشير العلامات إلى سيناريو أكثر صلابة ووعدًا.
يُعتبر التبني المؤسسي أحد الركائز الرئيسية لهذا التفاؤل. لقد بدأت الصناديق الكبيرة والشركات واللاعبون التقليديون يرون أن العملات المشفرة جزء من البنية التحتية المالية العالمية الجديدة. إن وصول المنتجات المنظمة، مثل صناديق الاستثمار المتداولة، يزيد من الوصول، ويجلب السيولة، ويعزز مصداقية السوق.
نقطة أساسية أخرى هي تقدم التنظيم. القواعد الأكثر وضوحًا تساعد على حماية المستثمرين، وتقليل المخاطر، وجذب رأس المال على المدى الطويل. على عكس ما يعتقده الكثيرون، فإن التنظيم لا يعيق الابتكار، بل يخلق بيئة أكثر صحة لنمو النظام البيئي.
في المجال التكنولوجي، التطور مستمر. أصبحت سلاسل الكتل أسرع وأرخص وأكثر كفاءة. من المرجح أن تكتسب حالات الاستخدام مثل المدفوعات العالمية، والتمويل اللامركزي، وتوكنيزات الأصول الحقيقية، والهوية الرقمية مزيدًا من الأهمية في السنوات القادمة.
يستمر البيتكوين، بعرضه المحدود وسياسته النقدية المتوقعة، في الترسخ كاحتياطي رقمي للقيمة، خاصة في عالم حيث تستمر العملات الورقية في الطباعة بدون حدود واضحة.
على الرغم من التقلبات، لم تكن أسس السوق قوية بهذا الشكل من قبل. من المرجح أن يكون الدورة القادمة أقل تركيزًا على الضجيج وأكثر على التبني الحقيقي، والبناء، والرؤية على المدى الطويل.
دراسة وفهم المخاطر والتفكير على المدى الطويل يُحدث فرقًا كبيرًا.

title: ETH Weakens Despite Aggressive Accumulation by BitMine – Where Could the Next Correction Lead?
subTitle:
Ethereum continues to show signs of weakness even as large institutional players increase their exposure. Ethereum treasury firm BitMine Immersion has doubled down on its long-term strategy by purchasing an additional 102,259 ETH over the past week — marking its largest accumulation since the previous disclosure.
This latest acquisition brings BitMine’s total Ethereum holdings to approximately 3.96 million ETH, valued at around $11.82 billion at current market prices. The company has made its ambition clear: to ultimately control 5% of Ethereum’s circulating supply.
In a statement released on Monday, BitMine Chairman Thomas Lee highlighted that 2025 is shaping up to be a pivotal year for digital assets, citing more crypto-friendly U.S. legislation, clearer regulatory frameworks, and growing support from Wall Street. According to Lee, these macro tailwinds reinforce BitMine’s conviction that the strongest phase of the crypto bull cycle may still lie ahead, justifying its aggressive ETH accumulation strategy — internally referred to as the company’s “5% alchemy goal.”
Beyond Ethereum, BitMine also holds 193 BTC, a $38 million investment in Worldcoin (WLD) treasury assets, stakes in Eightco Holdings, and approximately $1 billion in cash reserves.
Thanks to this latest ETH purchase, BitMine has become the second-largest crypto treasury company globally, trailing only Strategy, while officially ranking first in Ethereum treasury holdings, surpassing SharpLink Gaming.
However, this rapid expansion comes with notable risks. According to data compiled by Maartunn, a community analyst at CryptoQuant, BitMine is currently sitting on an unrealized loss of roughly $3 billion.
Reflecting market concerns, BitMine’s stock price fell 9% on Monday, coinciding with the release of the updated holdings report.
Ethereum Price Outlook: ETH Eyes the $2,850 Support After a 5% Drop
Ethereum saw $174 million in liquidations over the past 24 hours, with long positions accounting for $141.8 million, according to Coinglass data.
ETH’s recovery attempt was decisively rejected near the $3,100 resistance, triggering a sharp 5% decline on Monday. Price action is now hovering dangerously close to a key support zone around $2,850.
If ETH fails to hold above $2,850, downside pressure could intensify, potentially dragging price toward the $2,600 support area. A deeper correction may expose the next major demand zone near $2,380.
On the bullish side, Ethereum must reclaim $3,100 and break back above the 50-day, 100-day, and 200-day exponential moving averages (EMAs) to re-establish a sustainable uptrend.
From a technical perspective, the Relative Strength Index (RSI) has slipped below the neutral level, signaling weakening momentum, while the Stochastic Oscillator is approaching the oversold zone. A confirmed oversold reading could act as a catalyst for a short-term relief bounce.

title: 以太坊最新价格与趋势解析：震荡筑底还是继续回调？
subTitle:
从价格表现来看，当前以太坊（ETH）整体处于**中期下行修正、短期震荡筑底**的阶段，尚未走出明确方向。对越南的个人投资者而言，这更像是一段“耐心期”，而不是一击即中的暴利窗口。
一、价格与市场情绪概况  
1. 价格区间与走势特征  
- 近期 $ETH 多次在 2900–3100 美元附近拉锯，短线多空频繁博弈。  
- 部分技术分析认为，ETH 正在一个**下降通道**中运行，价格在 2900 美元附近测试支撑，上方 3100–3200 美金是重要压力区，一旦反弹到 3100 以上容易再度遇压回落。  
- 传统金融数据也显示，ETH 近期日跌幅一度达到 4–5%，说明短线抛压并不小，投资者风险偏好降温明显。  
2. 市场情绪与资金流向  
- 技术指标层面，很多分析将当前定性为**短期偏空、情绪偏谨慎**的阶段，价格运行在关键均线（如 4H 与日线 EMA）之下，趋势多头尚未重掌主导权。  
- 另一方面，**中长期资金（所谓“鲸鱼”以及机构）并未明显撤退**，反而在关键支撑区持续缓慢增持，ETF 等机构渠道整体净流入仍保持正值，说明真正长期资金对 ETH 的中长期前景并不悲观。  
- 整个加密市场目前普遍低迷，主流币中有超过一半的币价都在重要均线之下，整体更接近“熊市后期/震荡筑底”而非“轮番新高”的热烈周期。
二、最新基本面与宏观环境要点  
1. 以太坊自身基本面  
- 网络层面：L2 扩容、Rollup、模块化架构推进，使得以太坊作为底层结算层的**“基础设施属性”进一步强化**，Gas 成本与性能瓶颈逐步缓解。  
- 供给层面：在 PoS + EIP-1559 模式下，ETH 依然存在长期“接近通缩/轻微通缩”的特征，叠加长期锁仓于质押与 DeFi 之中，**流通筹码趋紧**这一逻辑仍在。  
- 生态层面：DeFi、RWA（现实世界资产上链）、链上衍生品等板块主要还是在以太坊及其 L2 上发展，ETH 作为“生态核心抵押资产”的地位暂时无可替代。
2. 宏观与政策氛围  
- 美国大选后市场多次押注“更友好的加密监管环境”，一度推动 BTC、ETH 上冲，但近期情绪降温、加息预期与监管不确定性仍在反复，风险资产整体承压。  
- 传统市场中，美股科技股与纳指相对仍偏强，但对高波动资产的偏好不如牛市顶峰阶段，资金更谨慎地选择“逢低布局、而非追高狂欢”。  
- 对越南投资者而言，本地法币与美元之间的汇率因素、政策环境也会放大加密资产的波动感受，在心态上更需注意仓位与杠杆控制。
三、技术结构与趋势解读  
1. 短期（接下来数日到数周）  
- 价格处于 2900 美元附近支撑区域震荡，若跌破这一带并有效放量，技术上可能打开向下空间，测试 2600–2700 区域。  
- 上方关键的**短线压力带在 3100–3200 美元**，若反弹至该区域但量能不足、K 线形态偏弱，容易再度被空头打回。  
- 多数技术流分析将当前定义为：  
  - 结构：下行通道内的**反弹 + 再下探**节奏概率较大；  
  - 指标：价格低于重要均线，RSI 等指标反弹至趋势线附近时，反而更容易成为新一轮下跌信号。
2. 中期（接下来数月，指向 2026）  
- 有分析认为，ETH 当前这一轮震荡更像是在为 2026 年的潜在上行做“筑底与换手”：  
  - 价格虽反复下探，但大额地址和机构仍在关键价位附近缓慢吸筹；  
  - ETF 等机构产品资金流入为中长期价格提供了“隐形托底”；  
  - 盘面上表现为：**价格跌得不算猛，但涨也不干脆**——典型的“筹码再分配期”。  
- 若后续宏观环境转好、监管不确定性缓和，加之以太坊技术路线持续兑现，不排除 ETH 在 2026 年迎来新一轮突破，挑战甚至超越历史高位。但这属于中长期逻辑，不等同于短期立即拉升。
四、对越南个人投资者的操作建议  
以下为策略思路，不构成任何投资承诺，请结合自身风险承受能力独立判断。
1. 已持有 ETH 的投资者  
- 心态定位：将当前阶段视作**中期回调 + 震荡筑底期**，而不是“牛市顶点”。如果你的投资周期在 1–3 年以上，可以：  
  - 继续持有主仓，将波动视为正常噪音；  
  - 避免在情绪恐慌时砍在明显支撑位附近。  
- 分批操作：  
  - 若 ETH 再次接近或跌破 2900 美元且无重大利空，可考虑用少量资金**分批补仓**，而非一次性 All-in；  
  - 若后续反弹到 3200–3400 区域，且你本身风险厌恶，可考虑**分批减仓锁定部分利润或降低成本**。  
- 控制风险：不要因为“看好中长期”就放任高杠杆或过度集中持仓，一次极端回撤足以打乱整个投资计划。
2. 准备建仓 ETH 的投资者  
- 建仓节奏：  
  - 避免追涨式一次性买入，采用 “分三到五笔、分价位铺量” 的方式更合理；  
  - 可以将大致计划价位分布在：  
    - 第一档：接近当前区间（如 2900–3000），  
    - 第二档：若出现进一步回调（如 2600–2700），  
    - 第三档：留出一部分现金应对“意外极端行情”。  
- 风险与仓位管理：  
  - 先根据家庭资产状况为加密资产设定**总比例上限**（例如不超过可投资资产的 10–20%，视个人风险承受能力而定），再在此之内决定 ETH 占比。  
  - 避免使用高倍合约，只在真正理解风险后再考虑轻微杠杆，且要严格设置止损与强平线。
3. 短线与合约交易者  
- 短期结构偏空：当前处在下行通道中，技术上逢反弹放空往往比盲目抄底成功率更高，但前提是你有成熟的交易系统与严格风控。  
- 关键位参考：  
  - 上方 3100–3200 美元是明显阻力区，若价格反弹至此且量能缩减、指标背离，短空机会较多；  
  - 下方 2900 一线若被放量跌破，可能引发一轮加速下探，要谨防“刀口接飞刀”。  
- 风险提示：合约对时间和纪律要求极高，大部分散户亏损集中在情绪化加杠杆与频繁重仓博弈上，不建议将生活必需资金投入高杠杆交易。
五、适合当前阶段的心态与策略框架  
- 认清周期：现在更接近**“熊市后期 / 震荡期”**而非全面狂热牛市，收益与风险都不会像牛市顶点那样极端，但“熬时间”的要求更高。  
- 坚持研究：对于越南投资者而言，汇率、监管以及本地金融环境都会造成额外不确定性，更需要在下单之前弄清：  
  - 自己买 ETH 的逻辑是什么（技术、生态、通缩、长期趋势等）；  
  - 若价格短期再跌 20–30%，是否仍能承受且愿意继续持有。  
- 保持现金弹性：在高波动资产中，**现金也是一种重要头寸**。适度留有现金，可以在未来真正的极端低价出现时，拥有出手的资格，而不是被动观望。
总体而言，ETH 当前阶段的关键词是：**短期偏空震荡、中期潜在筑底、长期仍具逻辑**。对越南的个人投资者来说，比起猜明天涨跌，更重要的是：设定自己的时间维度、清晰资产配置比例，并坚定执行分批与风控规则。
